# Synthetic speech fixtures

Generated October13,2026 using Windows System.Speech.Synthesis with Microsoft David Desktop and Microsoft Zira Desktop. These are machine-generated original neutral phrases, with no human/Discord recording. Short David input: "Violet." Repeated Zira input: "Violet moon." three times. Long David input: the same phrase twenty times. WAV metadata contains no user credentials or identifiers. Silence is generated mathematically in the evaluator.

These two artificial American-English voices do not qualify accent coverage, real overlapping acoustic speech, conversation or long-duration soak. Separate concurrent speaker streams measure application attribution/queue behavior, matching Discord's separate SSRC streams; they are not a mixed microphone recording.
